title: Mother’s Jewelry Box
description: This painting belongs to my Favorite Objects series, focusing on close-up depictions of intimate items carrying deep personal history. Featured here is my mother’s ceramic jewelry box - a piece rendered in vivid, layered green tones, set against a rich, contrasting blue background. Over decades, this delicate object was broken and reassembled countless times. The extreme close-up composition emphasizes the tactile memory of home, maternal affection, and the fragile nature of time.

images.alt: Mother’s Jewelry Box, acrylic on canvas
